thread:
anika: Heads up — OrionaCloud notified us that the reserved A100 shipment for Dedicated pools is being split. ~60% on the original ETA, remaining 40% delayed by ~10–14 days. This affects the April commit window. :eyes:

matt: Ugh. Do we have an updated manifest or PO change?

partner-bot: Shipment notice: PO# OC-67211 — items: 24x A100-80GB (GPU), split shipments: 14 units ETA 2026-04-08, 10 units ETA 2026-04-20. Tracking: https://shipments.oriona/OC-67211

olivia: Can we still hit SLA for Dedicated customers who signed up for committed capacity? Which customers will be impacted if we can't provision full pool by 4/10?

anika: Short answer: 3 customers on Dedicated commit for next billing cycle will see reduced peak throughput. I'll list them in PMs. Need a plan for marketplace listings + communication.

sam: Suggestions: 1) Offer a temporary routing to compatible lower-memory instances (e.g., A40/RTX6000) for non-VIP routes, 2) enable burst credits from spare pool, 3) notify customers with ETA and mitigation plan.

matt: We should avoid a public marketplace change if possible. Can we do internal routing/throttling without changing the listing?

zach: Ops note — switching to fallback model variants requires updating the routing policy in prod. I can push a canary to 10% traffic to test performance impact. Need greenlight.

olivia: For communications: draft channel + owners: sales-engineering (customer comm), support (tickets), legal (contract change), marketing (if public). I'll draft an email template after we confirm fallback.

anika: Risk matrix quick: Impacted customers = 3 (high), potential SLA credit exposure = medium, marketplace listing unaffected if we keep commitments via fallback, hardware partner remorse = low but increasing.

sam: If we route to A40, we should set clear token limits and latency guidance. Add a short notice in the tenant console: "Temporary capacity substitution — performance may vary".

matt: Can devex prepare a short FAQ and kb article? Link to shared playbook for incidents like this.

partner-bot: Action required: confirm whether Redwood will accept split shipments as-is or request supplier consolidation. Deadline to notify OrionaCloud: 2026-03-24 18:00 UTC.

anika: Proposal: Accept split shipment, trigger fallback routing + burst credits, notify customers with 24h ETA note, and request expedited second-leg shipping. Who owns?

olivia: I can own customer comms. Sam + Zach handle technical fallback. Matt coordinate with procurement on expedited shipping request.

sam: I'll draft the routing change and canary config. Example patch to rollout (preview):

```
route-policy:
  name: oc-a100-split-fallback
  match: model.family == "a100"
  fallback: ["a40-32gb-quant", "a100-40gb-quant"]
  canary: 0.10
  token_limit_overrides:
    default: 0.8
```

sam: Will run canary at 10% for 1 hour, monitor latency and error rate.

zach: I'll prepare dashboard widgets: per-route latency, error rate, cost delta. Add an eval prompt set to check output quality on fallback.

matt: Procurement update — I'll ask Oriona if they can prioritize the second leg and confirm penalty clauses. Sending legal the PO now.

anika: Good. Next steps: Olivia send first-draft comm in 2 hours, Sam/Zach validate canary by EOD, Matt update procurement, I'll follow up with partner PM. We'll reconvene 4/28 09:30 PT if anything changes. :thumbsup:

olivia: Draft sent to thread (PM copy).

sam: Canary config queued in staging.

zach: Dashboards ready — will attach to the incident channel once canary starts.

matt: Procurement asked Oriona for expedited second leg; they responded "evaluating options".

anika: Thanks all. Keep notes here and in the ticket (PRJ-4921).

olivia: Notifying impacted customers now. Will include fallback details and expected final delivery window.

matt: Update from Oriona: they can move 2 units from later leg to earlier via air freight at extra cost — decision needed within 6 hours.

anika: Decision: approve air freight for 2 units to reduce impact on VIP customer. Matt, proceed.

partner-bot: Update logged: change requested to PO# OC-67211 (move 2 units to leg 1). Ticket OC-9872 created.

zach: Kicking the canary in 5 mins.

sam: Canary started. Monitoring... :eyes:

zach: Canary metrics look acceptable — latency +12% p95, errors within SLO.

olivia: Customers acknowledged receipt of comms, one asked for a follow-up call.

anika: Closing thread for now. We'll keep the ticket open until full delivery. Thanks.
